title: TEKO u9.0.0 BETA!
content:
Finally. The new version is here!
I'm almost done with all the new systems and features, along with the biggest aesthetic overhaul in TEKO's entire history.
To try out this version, you'll have to go through your Steam library:
Settings > Game versions & Betas > Private versions (Check Code).
tekobeta1234

Select the beta version, the game will update, and you'll be ready to play the new version.

There will be tentative changes, things that aren't 100% finished yet, but overall it's already working pretty well. There might be crashes, bugs, exploits... so please, report all issues on Discord! I enter every day and check all the reports.

I recommend backing up your data at C:/Users/-/AppData/Local/TEKO.

I need testers. This version is focused on QoL and aesthetics, and making sure everything runs smoothly without bugs. There are so many changes! I've been working on this update for over 2 months. Later I'll make a detailed report with every change made, but for now I'll leave you with the surprise until you hop in.

The plan is that, after finishing 9.0, I can resume my normal activity by making a version 10.0 with tons of new content. So I hope everything goes well.

The only way to go back from the beta to the original version is by deleting your cloud data and Memories history, so I really don't recommend going backward (anyway, this new 9.0 beta version is much better than the live 8.0, so there's no point in going back), but I'm letting you know just in case someone wants to play both versions at the same time: due to the structural change between the two, it's hard to keep the data. If you go back from 9.0 to 8.0 without deleting your Memories, there will be a crash because the old version can't read the new strings.

• Fixed Lankvian Card's logic when it's on the right. Previously, there was a bug that made it activate on any chip that retriggers. Now it only works with the first one selected.
  • The number of chips (the text above the pocket sprite) wasn't updating after using Printer. Additionally, a translated text was missing on this consumable's screen. This was fixed.
  • Adjusted the triggering for the Teko Card achievement. It wasn't unlocking properly.
  • Promoted Card will always unequip excess mods. Previously, an exploit was possible: if a Card evolved from Rare to Epic (losing 1 slot), and it had 3 mods equipped that take up only 1 slot each, those 3 mods would stay equipped instead of unequipping one.
Fixed an exploit with the Stamp Block Consumable. With this, it was practically possible to win any run.
Fixed the missing interaction between special combos and The Based Card when the player is using Outlaw Pocket. Some achievements weren't working either. It's all been fixed now.

Fixed a very annoying bug that didn't let you play normally if you had fewer chips than draws. The system would freeze because it tried to draw something that was no longer there. It's been fixed now, it should work properly.

Fixed a Filling Card bug. Several of the mods it copied weren't working, now they should work correctly. Added the mods it can't copy to its description.

I'm evaluating several things regarding mods, don't panic if there are some changes.

There are extreme situations that break the game's limits, I'll keep an eye on the interactions of draws, mods, tubes/tray/pillbox efficiency, etc.

title: Important news
content:
Hi. As you may know, I've made several announcements lately, but I forgot to mention something.

I actually couldn't decide whether to do it or not, but now it's very clear to me. I know I've been mediocre in the past, but I keep working to be a better version of myself. And, above all, I've learned that I need to take my time with things. As the months go by I'm much more patient. That's why, temporarily, the TEKO DEMO won't be visible on the store.

I'm currently doing a complete overhaul of the DEMO so it matches the full game exactly (but with limited content). The reason I don't want more people playing the current version is because it's full of bugs and is way too different from the EA: The EA version is truly incomparable, it's far better than the demo... so that difference means I'm sabotaging myself and generating defamation for my own game. Since the demo is bad, the result is counterproductive; rather than promoting the full version, it drives new players away. I made a huge mistake. I shouldn't have left such an immature demo up.

But well, that's how I learn. With mistakes, because nobody taught me. It's simply a matter of time before everything gets much better.

At the same time, I want you to know that I'm working very hard. As you've probably seen, after finishing TEKO's base content, I've been working in the shadows. I'm progressing very fast. And when I have news, I'm going to need your help to thoroughly test everything before making the version public.

u9.0 is going to be the biggest rework. It's crazy. I can't give too many spoilers, as I feel it's unnecessary; I want to save the surprise for the end. I can only assure you that everything is going to change. It will even be shocking at first, and it'll take players some time to get used to the change. This is going to be extreme.

And, based on the lessons I've learned from my past failures, I understand I need to take my time. I haven't felt burnt out for several days. This is a good sign. I'm starting to recover after pushing myself so hard. Right now I feel really good. I'm making a lot of significant changes, but without any pressure.

The only thing that worries me sometimes is that players might suffer because I'm inexperienced. There are many reasons why, due to my shortcomings in development, a player might not have a good time. Especially in the aesthetics, there are a lot of flaws. But there are also people who might complain about the balance (even though u8.0 is very forgiving).

But, at least I offer dialogue all the time, and that's my biggest strength: the connection with the community. That's why, if you have questions, want help to become a better player, or simply want to give feedback or chat, I can help you out on the Discord server.

I'm not going to promise anything, that would be absurd. I don't know what life has in store for me. The only thing I know is that right now I'm working many hours a day, and not only that, I have it in mind to make this a definitive project, something that is finished. I can't guarantee it, but that's what I'm thinking right now. And the players who have tried the EA version already know where this is heading; it's obvious the potential shines through.

So, that's what I wanted to tell you today: I'm highly focused on u9.0, which will take quite a while to come out but will be worth it and will be a historic milestone in TEKO's development; and, for the time being, the Demo won't be available (I'm really sorry, but it's for everyone's own good and it will pay off in the long run).

The next step after u9.0 is creating new graphical assets outside the game, like trailers, screenshots, a new description—basically an aesthetic revamp.

I don't want to hype you up any more. There are still many weeks to go. I hope you can join me in this, I swear this is my life, I only think about this, I love TEKO. And I'm happy that you're also slowly falling in love with this project. Thanks for everything.

I just fixed all the unlock conditions for the Cards that unlock when beating specific difficulties in certain Pockets.

I did a quick but huge nerf to the Mods.
Pipe/Hat Common Mods: REMOVED.
Pipe/Hat Rare Mods: +2 extra base > +1 extra base.

I made a giant mistake that I knew was going to end badly: adding too much stuff. In the past, I really wanted to add more Mod variety, and the ones that were hardest to create were the new Common Mods, so I decided to add a lower tier of Pipe/Hat, but now I see the results of that decision: the game completely broke. That's why I just did what I knew I had to do from the very beginning. I let it slide, I thought it wouldn't be abused this much, but... XD. For the sake of the game, I prefer having less variety but keeping everything more balanced. TEKO was unfairly forgiving.
Fixed a minor bug. Winning a run with Jean Pocket D4 used to unlock The Transgressor Card. This was not intended; it should be unlocked by winning with Drab Pocket D4.

I just fixed a small visual bug where texts weren't displaying correctly for any language, specifically when using the juice Consumables. When this happens, instead of the normal text, "KEY_NOT_FOUND" appears. I'm letting you know so that if it happens, you can report it correctly. When this text appears as a placeholder, it's because a localization text is missing or it was declared incorrectly.

I just fixed the issues related to having Sinister Cards and managing slot space. For example, now we'll be able to use Consumables like Mask or Binoculars even if we have more than 12 Cards. Previously, the system detected that if we had more Cards than slots, it wouldn't let us receive any new Cards, but this system changed with the new Sinister Cards that don't take up slots. It's been fixed now. I did the same with the Potentially Suspicious Man Card, which generated a Card every time you entered the shop.
